breakpoints.note: The first 9 bytes of the staged witness are `DSC-Image`, so `identify()` selects the Rollei parser and reaches the vulnerable `fgets(line, 128, ifp)` path.
First project-side read on the vulnerable path that materializes attacker-controlled Rollei metadata bytes into the stack buffer that is later overflowed.

On this witness there is no newline, so the loop exits only at EOF with `streamsize == 127`. That leaves `pdest - str == 127`, meaning `pdest` already points at the last in-bounds slot of `line[128]` before the post-loop terminator logic runs. The fix changes this bound, and the matching post-loop check, to `sz - 1`.
